_:
repo ~/i/edahogan/animators-hive-hub: sveltekit 2 (runes only) + tailwind v4 on cloudflare workers (@sveltejs/adapter-cloudflare). aliases $lib = src/lib, $components = src/components. bindings: d1 `DB` (database ahh), r2 `M` (bucket ahh). push to remote `mine` (public fork 144126/animators-hive-hub, branch main); never push `origin` (403).

goal: the level after plan `critical` (wip-plans/critical.plan.json): fix the app's remaining high, medium and low flaws from ~/search/animators-hive-hub-flaws.md. the project report is out of scope. settled with ed on 2026-10-07: all four tiers (security, product gaps, ux + a11y, tests + cleanup); no email sending, so no password reset or email verification; tmp/ leaves the fork in a normal commit, no history rewrite; new d1 migrations may be applied with --remote without asking.

deploy: every push to mine/main builds and deploys worker animators-hive-hub (tag ea40543f1ecf4508a33eb2fa9787c098) to https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev. after each push confirm the build with `cf builds list --external-script-id ea40543f1ecf4508a33eb2fa9787c098`; a failed build belongs to the step that pushed it. apply a step's new migration with --remote before pushing it.

code rules (ed): snake_case; no comments except a non-obvious why; all ui text lowercase; tailwind utilities and the tokens in src/app.css, no inline style. new db columns, new request/response json keys and page-load return keys are single letters, each commented where defined; existing api json shapes in src/lib/types.ts stay. all sql lives in src/lib/server/db.ts (lowercase); each function takes the D1Database from `sql(platform)` first; routes and pages stay thin. a new table gets `migrations/000N_<name>.sql` with a key comment above it, applied with `wrangler d1 migrations apply ahh --local` and `--remote`. internal links and goto use `resolve()` from $app/paths (lint rule svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve); the rule rejects every query-only href, so ?query navigation uses a GET <form>. errors: map `UNIQUE constraint failed: <t>.<c>` and `FOREIGN KEY constraint failed` to 400/404 json via `j()` from src/lib/server/session.ts, never a 500. ownership checks return 'ok' | 'not found' | 'forbidden' from db.ts and become 200/404/403 in the route.

checks: every gate runs `pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build`. steps that touch the api also run `node scripts/smoke.ts` against the dev server; extend it with each new api behaviour, use fresh `smk` + 8 hex users, and keep its last line `smoke ok <username> <every r2 key it left behind>`. from step e2e_setup on, steps that touch pages also run `pnpm test:e2e`. after step rate_limits, quick reruns can hit 429: wait a minute. pnpm output is filtered by rtk; prefix `rtk proxy` for raw output.

dev server: `pnpm dev` serves :8080, logs to .log, and reads wrangler.jsonc and .dev.vars only at start. restart it after changing either: kill the pid from `ss -ltnp 'sport = :8080'` (never pkill -f), then `setsid pnpm dev > .log 2>&1 < /dev/null &`. wrangler: always `env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler ...`.

commits: after each mark commit that step's files plus plan/ as a conventional commit `<type>(<scope>): <imperative, <=50 chars, lowercase>` with body bullets and the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`, then `git push mine main`.

order (ed, 2026-10-07): this is a school project to submit soon, so the visible work (ssr, people, ownership, community_join, ui, dead_code) runs first; security, e2e_setup and prod_verify come after. steps before e2e_setup do not run e2e.

db_sessions.s:
outcome: sessions live in d1, signing out kills the token on the server, and SESSION_SECRET is no longer used.
1. migrations/0002_sessions.sql:
-- s session: i sha-256 hex of the cookie token, u user, x expires ms, t created ms
create table s (i text primary key, u text not null references u (i) on delete cascade, x integer not null, t integer not null);
create index s_u on s (u);
2. src/lib/server/session.ts: write_session makes 32 random bytes (base64url) as cookie `ahh` (same flags), stores their sha-256 hex with a 30-day expiry, and deletes that user's expired rows. read_session hashes the cookie and returns the user row from db.ts `user_by_session(d, hash)` (join u, `x > now`) in one query. clear_session deletes the row and the cookie. delete sign(), secret() and every SESSION_SECRET use.
3. src/hooks.server.ts uses the row; src/routes/api/auth/signout/+server.ts awaits clear_session.
4. drop SESSION_SECRET from src/app.d.ts, .env.example, README.md and .dev.vars (prod's secret goes in step prod_verify).
5. smoke: after sign-out, A's old cookie gets `/api/me` user null.
db_sessions.t: test -f migrations/0002_sessions.sql && grep -q 'user_by_session' src/lib/server/db.ts && ! grep -rq SESSION_SECRET src .env.example README.md && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build && curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke.ts

rate_limits.s:
outcome: abusive request rates get a 429 before reaching any route.
1. wrangler.jsonc `ratelimits`: RL_AUTH namespace_id "1008" limit 30, RL_WRITE "1017" limit 120, RL_MEDIA "1026" limit 30, all `period: 60` (ids 1001-1007 belong to ed's other workers). type them in src/app.d.ts with `RateLimit` from @cloudflare/workers-types.
2. src/hooks.server.ts, after reading the session and before resolve: POST /api/auth/* and GET /login/google use RL_AUTH keyed by `cf-connecting-ip` (fallback 'local'); POST /api/media uses RL_MEDIA; every other non-GET /api/* uses RL_WRITE; those two are keyed by the signed-in user id, else the ip. over the limit: 429 json `{ error: 'too many requests, try again in a minute' }`.
3. confirm by hand that the 31st sign-in within a minute gets 429, then wait a minute before the gate.
rate_limits.t: grep -q '"ratelimits"' wrangler.jsonc && grep -q 'RL_AUTH' src/hooks.server.ts && grep -q 'too many requests' src/hooks.server.ts && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build && curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke.ts

2. enforce them in the api routes for sign-up, password, profile, animations, comments, playlists and communities: 400 `{ error: '<field> ...' }`, never silent truncation.
3. find_or_create_google pads usernames shorter than 3 chars with random hex.
4. forms take maxlength/minlength/pattern from src/lib/rules.ts.
5. smoke: a username with a space gets 400; a profile website `javascript:alert(1)` gets 400.
input_rules.t: test -f src/lib/rules.ts && grep -q 'rules' src/routes/api/auth/signup/+server.ts && grep -q 'rules' src/routes/api/profile/+server.ts && grep -q 'rules' src/routes/api/animations/+server.ts && grep -q 'rules' src/routes/api/comments/+server.ts && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build && curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke.ts

google_verified.s:
outcome: google sign-in only links or creates an account for an email google has verified.
in src/routes/google/+server.ts read `email_verified` from the userinfo json; unless it is `true`, respond 400 with the text 'google email not verified' and create nothing.
why: find_or_create_google in src/lib/server/db.ts signs into any existing account with the same email, so an unverified address could take one over.
google_verified.t: grep -q 'email_verified' src/routes/google/+server.ts && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build

e2e_setup.s:
outcome: browser tests run with `pnpm test:e2e` against the dev server, set up like ~/i/e4.
1. `pnpm add -D e2e @e2e-dev/web`; e2e.config.ts in the shape of ~/i/e4/e2e.config.ts (target http://localhost:8080, workers 1); package.json script `"test:e2e": "e2e run"`; docs live in node_modules/e2e/docs.
2. tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4 from `ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=320x180:d=1 -pix_fmt yuv420p tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4`.
3. tests/core.e2e.ts: a guest sees the landing page; signing up (random smk name) lands on discover; uploading tiny.mp4 with a title puts it in the feed with a thumbnail; its page has a video whose src starts with /media/; upvote shows 1; a posted comment appears.
4. tests/mobile.e2e.ts at 375x667: discover renders without horizontal scroll, and the header reaches /communities.
5. tests/core.e2e.ts also: open sign-in, press Escape, the dialog is gone; Tab stays inside while it is open.
6. add `pnpm test:e2e` to README.md.
e2e_setup.t: test -f e2e.config.ts && test -f tests/core.e2e.ts && test -f tests/mobile.e2e.ts && test -f tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4 && grep -q '"test:e2e"' package.json && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm build && curl -sf localhost:8080/api/me >/dev/null && pnpm test:e2e && grep -q 'communities' tests/mobile.e2e.ts

prod_verify.s:
outcome: the live app passes the smoke test with nothing left behind, rate limits answer 429, and prod holds only the secrets it uses.
1. `BASE=https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev node scripts/smoke.ts`.
2. delete what it made: `wrangler d1 execute ahh --remote --command "delete from u where n like 'smk%'"` (cascades) and every r2 key on its last line (`wrangler r2 object delete ahh/<key> --remote`).
3. `wrangler secret delete SESSION_SECRET --name animators-hive-hub` (unused since db_sessions).
4. send 31 wrong-password sign-ins for a random email to prod within a minute: the last answers 429.
prod_verify.t: ! env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler secret list --name animators-hive-hub | grep -q SESSION_SECRET && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN pnpm exec wrangler d1 execute ahh --remote --json --command "select count(*) as c from u where n like 'smk%'" | grep -q '"c": 0' && curl -sf https://animators-hive-hub.apexlinks.workers.dev/ >/dev/null
